tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page ground. Warband: char. Bastion: limestone.

tokens.name: ground-deep
tokens.usage: Vignette edge of the page and the well behind the banner.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels: the default container for every block of content.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards inside a panel: the codex pane, a macro, a hint.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Fields, code blocks, the JSON tree: anything the player types into or reads raw.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Row or menu item under the pointer.

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: Selected row, pressed command, the active tab's ground. Text stays `text`.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and sections. Decorative: carries no meaning.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, secondary buttons, tabs). At least 3:1 on `surface` and `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body copy on every ground, surface and `selected`.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy: intros, notes, status lines, disabled labels. On grounds and surfaces.

tokens.name: brass
tokens.usage: Titan brass: headings, labels and the selected tab's text, on grounds and surfaces.

tokens.name: brass-deep
tokens.usage: Ornament: panel corner brackets, tree and JSON guides, the banner rule. Never text.

tokens.name: wellspring
tokens.usage: The life-force at the core: primary actions, focus ring, links, the selection mark, success. On grounds and surfaces.

tokens.name: on-wellspring
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `wellspring` fill (the primary button).

tokens.name: wellspring-glow
tokens.usage: The faint core-light rising from the bottom of the page and the halo of a focused primary button. Never behind text it must be read against alone.

tokens.name: heraldry
tokens.usage: The faction colour of the theme (Warband oxblood, Bastion lapis): the banner's top band and the sigil field. Large shapes only.

tokens.name: on-heraldry
tokens.usage: Text on a `heraldry` fill.

tokens.name: order
tokens.usage: Order (the titans' ward): the "wowlab can edit" verdict text. Through the gate only.

tokens.name: order-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of the Order badge.

tokens.name: order-border
tokens.usage: Border of the Order badge, solid.

tokens.name: ruin
tokens.usage: Ruin (destruction): "wowlab won't touch", errors, findings. On grounds, surfaces and `ruin-bg`.

tokens.name: ruin-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of the Ruin badge and of an error notice.

tokens.name: ruin-border
tokens.usage: Border of the Ruin badge and error notice, solid and 2px.

tokens.name: void
tokens.usage: The Void (eldritch unknown): the "unknown" verdict, for files no map row describes.

tokens.name: void-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of the Void badge.

tokens.name: void-border
tokens.usage: Border of the Void badge, solid.

tokens.name: stone
tokens.usage: Stone (inert): "folder" and "not used".

tokens.name: stone-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of the Stone badge.

tokens.name: stone-border
tokens.usage: Border of the Stone badge, solid.

tokens.name: astral
tokens.usage: Astral (a path that points elsewhere): the link verdict. Also JSON keys.

tokens.name: astral-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of the Astral badge.

tokens.name: astral-border
tokens.usage: Border of the Astral badge, dotted.

tokens.name: blight
tokens.usage: Blight (decay from outside): "server may overwrite", the second badge on a file the server may replace.

tokens.name: blight-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of the Blight badge.

tokens.name: blight-border
tokens.usage: Border of the Blight badge, dashed.

tokens.name: jt-key
tokens.usage: JSON keys, on `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: jt-string
tokens.usage: JSON strings, on `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: jt-number
tokens.usage: JSON numbers, on `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: jt-literal
tokens.usage: true, false and null, on `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: gear-ground
tokens.usage: The gear table's ground, dark in both themes so item colours read as in the game.

tokens.name: gear-text
tokens.usage: Gear table text and Common items on `gear-ground`.

tokens.name: gear-muted
tokens.usage: Slot names and empty slots on `gear-ground`.

tokens.name: gear-heading
tokens.usage: Gear table column heads on `gear-ground`.

tokens.name: gear-row-rule
tokens.usage: Rule between gear rows.

tokens.name: gear-detail
tokens.usage: Ground of an expanded item's detail row; `gear-text` reads on it.

tokens.name: quality-poor
tokens.usage: Poor item names on `gear-ground`.

tokens.name: quality-common
tokens.usage: Common item names on `gear-ground`.

tokens.name: quality-uncommon
tokens.usage: Uncommon item names on `gear-ground`.

tokens.name: quality-rare
tokens.usage: Rare item names on `gear-ground`. The client's colour, kept exact: 4.0:1, large text only, so names are set in `item-name`.

tokens.name: quality-epic
tokens.usage: Epic item names on `gear-ground`. The client's colour, kept exact: 3.9:1, large text only.

tokens.name: quality-legendary
tokens.usage: Legendary item names on `gear-ground`.

tokens.name: quality-artifact
tokens.usage: Artifact item names on `gear-ground`.

tokens.name: quality-heirloom
tokens.usage: Heirloom item names on `gear-ground`.

families.serif: Alegreya, "Iowan Old Style", "Palatino Linotype", Palatino, Georgia, serif
families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The app's name in the banner, in `brass`. Once per page.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: The codex pane's title and a view's one heading.

styles.name: item-name
styles.usage: Item names in their quality colour: large text, so the client's colours pass 3:1.

styles.name: body-small
styles.usage: Field help, hint notes, read-only footers.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: written by the client at logout

styles.name: code-small
styles.usage: The JSON tree, item levels, snapshot ids.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Inside a row: badge to badge, icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Control padding, tab gap, list item gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Toolbar gap, table cell padding, hint padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding, gap between fields.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between panels; codex pane padding; page gutter on narrow screens.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutter on wide screens; space above a view heading.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Banner height padding and the gap before a new view section.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Controls, badges, rows: cut stone, barely softened.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Panels, the codex pane, buttons.

ornament.note: The titan-carved corner bracket drawn on panels and the codex pane.

tokens.name: ornament-arm
tokens.usage: Length of each arm of a corner bracket.

tokens.name: ornament-weight
tokens.usage: Stroke of a corner bracket and of the banner rule.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Every panel and the codex pane.

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: The life-force halo: a hovered or focused primary button and the Confirm seal. Once per view.
